RunStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of a single evaluation run.

The states form a mostly linear progression from ``queued`` through
``processing`` to a terminal ``completed``/``failed``/``cancelled`` state.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

description:
A single execution of one scenario version by one system version.

A run is the atomic unit of evaluation. It references the exact pinned
versions it exercised, records its lifecycle status and timing, and points
at the trace it produced. All timestamps are timezone-aware UTC.

failure_reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is failed.
failure_reason.title: Failure Reason

finished_at.description: When the run reached a terminal state, if it has.
finished_at.title: Finished At

seed.description: Random seed used for this run.
seed.title: Seed

started_at.description: When execution began, if it has started.
started_at.title: Started At

suite_execution_id.description: Suite execution this run belongs to.

trace_uri.description: Location of the raw event trace for this run.
trace_uri.title: Trace Uri

worker_id.description: Identifier of the worker that executed the run.
worker_id.title: Worker Id

title: Run
